items.text: It is "does this door read my result, and for how long".
IISER takes IAT only, and IISc BS takes JEE Advanced or IAT.

blocks.heading: How Long Your JEE Result Stays Useful

items.text: A JEE result is not a permanent pass.
JoSAA 2026 was expected to finish around 20 July 2026.
The counselling date comes from a coaching site.

blocks.heading: JEE But Still Give You a B.tech

items.text: The Navy and Army cadet entries use a JEE Main result, so they show up in every "after JEE" list.
You enter as a naval cadet through JEE Main rank and SSB.
Best for: students who want the uniform more than the B.Tech label.
The same ledger gives three different plans, depending on what you hold today.
Your 2026 JEE Main or Advanced result opened its doors in the 2026 cycle.
Best for: a drop year spent on one new test, plus one proof asset.

blocks.heading: Four Questions Before You Pick a Door

items.text: Before you commit, check your fit, your situation, the job market and AI-proofing.
Can you hold a pencil and a design for hours, wait years on a research ladder, run to a whistle, or live months at sea.
A rank you are proud of does not decide your daily work.

blocks.heading: Headroom, and What Caps the Rest

items.text: UCEED, NID, a CUET BSc and the IIT Madras BS all lead to work you can show before you graduate: a portfolio, a dataset, a shipped tool.
Best for: students who will build visible work every week.
A high-value skill portfolio is one core skill, one multiplier skill and finished proof that someone else can check.

blocks.heading: Pages Say Vs What the Notice Says

figures.label: Available Course Seats
figures.source: B.Arch is about 0.9% of JoSAA's 67,323 seats, and the four B.Arch seats we could check closed between Paper 2A ranks 207 and 1,983 last year.

figures.label: Available Course Seats
figures.source: If you want to leave engineering and also use your rank, the pool is under 1% of the seats JoSAA sells.

figures.label: Available Job Vacancies
figures.source: The three service cadet courses together had 194 vacancies in one cycle (44 Navy in July 2026, 60 Navy for January 2027, 90 Army).

figures.label: Exam Candidate Count
figures.source: About 7,900 candidates cleared the NDA I 2026 written round for the SSB, against 394 vacancies reported for NDA II 2026.

figures.label: Available Course Seats
figures.source: There are two hard filters: a rank in the top 0.5% to 5% of Paper 2A for the best government seats, then the first strong placement or practice.

figures.label: Available Course Seats
figures.source: About 79 students sat IAT for each IISER seat in 2026.

figures.label: Allocated Budget Share
figures.source: As a strict planning rule, treat about 10% of the total education budget as the starting cap for college fees, and about 20% as a caution line.

figures.label: Total Education Cost
figures.source: Parts of data and design can be learned from free or low-cost material: YouTube courses, official documentation and open courseware such as NPTEL, where the certificate exam costs ₹1,000.

figures.label: Education Budget Example
figures.source: An illustration, not a real fee: on a ₹3 lakh education budget, a tenth is ₹30,000 for the main course and a fifth is ₹60,000.
